# The Teachers' Room

> The Teachers' Room is a web app for teachers to create, edit, play, and share classroom games and quizzes, including AI-assisted game creation and live quizzes.

Teachers can turn a lesson topic, learning objective, or source material into classroom activities. Available formats include trivia, live quizzes, Jeopardy-style games, word games, board games, and review activities. Teachers remain able to review and edit generated questions, answers, images, and settings before classroom use.

## Product

- [The Teachers' Room](https://www.theteachersroom.app/): Product overview and entry point.
- [Classroom Game Hub](https://www.theteachersroom.app/games): Browse game formats and create, edit, save, play, or share classroom games.
- [Create Classroom Games with AI](https://www.theteachersroom.app/create-classroom-games): Overview of creating games from lesson topics, objectives, or source material.
- [Classroom Quiz Maker](https://www.theteachersroom.app/classroom-quiz-maker): Create trivia, live quizzes, and team review games.
- [Live Quizzes for Teachers](https://www.theteachersroom.app/live-quiz-for-teachers): Run real-time quizzes that students join using a code or QR link.
- [ESL Classroom Games](https://www.theteachersroom.app/esl-classroom-games): Create vocabulary, grammar, speaking, and review games for English language learners.

## Game types

- [Trivia](https://www.theteachersroom.app/game-types/trivia): Turn questions into a colourful team game.
- [Jeopardy](https://www.theteachersroom.app/game-types/jeopardy): Choose categories and point values for team review.
- [Time Bomb](https://www.theteachersroom.app/game-types/time-bomb): Answer questions against a countdown.
- [Wordwheel](https://www.theteachersroom.app/game-types/wordwheel): Build words from a wheel of letters.
- [Block Beaters](https://www.theteachersroom.app/game-types/blockbeaters): Answer questions to claim spaces on a hexagonal board.
- [Live Quiz](https://www.theteachersroom.app/game-types/live-quiz): Let students join and answer on their own devices.
- [Pub Quiz](https://www.theteachersroom.app/game-types/pub-quiz): Play a classroom quiz in themed rounds.
- [Survey Showdown](https://www.theteachersroom.app/game-types/survey-showdown): Guess the answers hidden on a team game board.
- [Stop the Fire](https://www.theteachersroom.app/game-types/stop-the-fire): Answer questions to keep the classroom challenge going.
- [Millionaire Maker](https://www.theteachersroom.app/game-types/millionaire-maker): Climb a question ladder with help options.
- [Darts Challenge](https://www.theteachersroom.app/game-types/darts-challenge): Pair correct answers with a darts game.
- [Snakes and Ladders](https://www.theteachersroom.app/game-types/snakes-and-ladders): Move around a board by answering questions.
